October, 2025

 In The High Court Of Andhra Pradesh

At Amaravati [3396]
 (Special Original Jurisdiction)
 Wednesday, The Eighth Day Of October
 Two Thousand And Twenty Five
 Present
 The Honourable Dr Justice Venkata Jyothirmai Pratapa
 Criminal Petition No: 8194/2023
Between:
 1. Mr.P.Nageswara Rao, S/O. Sri. P. Pitchayya, Aged About
 68 Years, Occ Private Service, Office At 8-2-268/K137 And
 39, Plot No. 37 And 39, Navodaya Colony, Banjara Hills,
 Hyderabad
 ...Petitioner/Accused
 And
 1.
THE STATE OF ANDHRA PRADESH, REPRESENTED BY THE  INSPECTOR OF POLICE, CHILAKALURIPET TOWN P.S. PALANADU  DISTRICT  2.

HAVING ITS OFFICE ONTHE 7TH H FLOOR, RAGHAVA NORTH  BLOCK, RAGHAVA RATNA TOWERS, CHIRAG ALL LANE, ABIDS,
 HYDERABAD 500 001 BEING REPRESENTED BY ITS AUTHORISED  SIGNATORY MR. VENU THOTTAMPUDI S/O SUBBARAO AGE 55  OCCU BUSINEE

3. THOTTEMPUDI VENU, S/O. V. SUBBARAO AGED ABOUT 55  YEARS, HAVING ITS OFFICE ONTHE 7TH FLOOR, RAGHAVA  NORTH BLOCK, RAGHAVA RATNA TOWERS, CHIRAG ALI LANE,
 ABIDS, HYDERABAD 500 001  ...RESPONDENT/COMPLAINANT(S):
Counsel for the Petitioner/accused:
 1. D S SIVADARSHAN Counsel for the Respondent/complainant(S):
 1. VIVEK CHANDRA SEKHAR S  2. PUBLIC PROSECUTOR (AP)
The Court made the following:
ORDER:
The instant petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C., has been filed by the Petitioner/Accused, seeking quashment of proceedings against him in Crime No. 254 of 2023 of Chilakaluripet Town Police Station, Palnadu District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 468 and 471 IPC.

sentences.text: 2. Heard Sri D.Siva Darshan, learned counsel for the petitioner.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the crime which is registered against the petitioner has closed due to lack of evidence and hence no cause survives for adjudication in the Criminal Petition and the matter has become infructuous.
4. Recording the said submissions, the Criminal Petition is dismissed as infructuous.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.
